posts.title: Wild Horse Nine @ Κινηματογράφος ΔΙΑΝΑ
posts.description: Excellent! Incredible cast, beautiful and unique setting of chile and easter island. Really fun premise and great conspiracy fodder. Steve Buscemi was particularly magnetic, but every actor was brilliant.

posts.title: Athens Greeknotes 22 Nov
posts.description: A fun and v cultural weekend after a couple of hot, sunny, but lousy weeks. Contemporary art! Cinema! Books!

posts.title: The End of the Affair by Graham Greene
posts.description: Probably the first Greene novel I didn't love. Exquisite writing as always, but the story about a writer having an affair, his relationship with her husband, and a load of tedious catholicism left me cold.
